def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    path = 'data/legal/input/csn-data-book-2024-csv/CSVs/2024_CSN_Top_Three_Identity_Theft_Reports_by_Year.csv'
    # File has a title row, blank rows, and a header row within the file.
    df = pd.read_csv(path, header=None)
    df.columns = ['col0','col1','col2']
    # Keep only rows where col0 looks like a year
    df = df[df['col0'].astype(str).str.fullmatch(r'\d{4}', na=False)].copy()
    df = df.rename(columns={'col0':'Year','col1':'Theft Type','col2':'Reports'})
    df['Year'] = df['Year'].astype(int)
    df['Reports'] = (
        df['Reports']
          .astype(str)
          .str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
          .str.strip()
    )
    df['Reports'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Reports'], errors='coerce')
    df = df.dropna(subset=['Reports','Theft Type','Year'])
    return df

def process(it_reports):
    import pandas as pd
    df = it_reports.copy()
    # Pivot to get 2020 and 2024 per theft type
    piv = df.pivot(index='Theft Type', columns='Year', values='Reports')
    # Keep only 2020 and 2024
    piv = piv[[2020, 2024]].dropna()
    piv.columns = ['reports_2020', 'reports_2024']
    piv = piv.reset_index()
    # Relative growth = (2024-2020)/2020
    piv['relative_growth'] = (piv['reports_2024'] - piv['reports_2020']) / piv['reports_2020']
    # Also compute multiplier for readability
    piv['growth_multiplier'] = piv['reports_2024'] / piv['reports_2020']
    return piv.sort_values('relative_growth', ascending=False)
